issue: Inconsistent/missing sign-in enforcement for direct navigation to protected routes
actual: Action-triggered attempts are handled well while logged out: clicking 'Add to Cart' redirects to /login with toast 'Please log in to add items to your cart', and 'Message Seller' shows a dialog with a disabled 'Log in to message' button. However, directly navigating (URL) to protected routes /create-listing, /cart, and /my-listings while unauthenticated renders a completely blank page (no header content, no form, no message, no redirect to /login) — confirmed via DOM inspection showing empty body innerText and empty semantic_snapshot for each of the three routes. This is not a clear sign-in prompt or redirect as required.

issue: No seller-facing UI exists to view purchase requests or buyer messages
actual: Bob (buyer) successfully added Alice's 'QA Final Test Bicycle' to cart and sent a purchase request via the cart's 'Send Purchase Request' button, receiving toast 'Purchase requests sent to sellers!' (confirming the second half of this item works: cart request reported sent). However, when Alice (seller/owner) logged back in, there is no way to view the request or any buyer message: the header has no notifications/messages icon, 'My Profile' route returns 404, 'My Listings' page shows no request indicator, and the owner's own product detail page shows no requests/messages section at all — just title/description/seller info and a 'Manage Your Listings' link.

evidence: After Alice marked 'QA Final Test Bicycle' sold, it disappeared from browse results (10 items shown, was 11). Bob (signed-in, non-owner) navigating directly to its product URL saw 'This item is no longer available' with Add to Cart and Message Seller buttons completely absent - no way to add to cart or start a purchase request for a sold item.

Product detail page for 'Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf' (prod-10) shows photo, Upcycled badge, title, description, price $320, category Furniture, condition New, location 'Portland, OR (9 mi)', listed date 2024-11-23, and seller James Wilson - all consistent with the browse card. Availability is represented consistently: available items show Add to Cart/Message Seller buttons, while a sold item (QA Final Test Bicycle, tested earlier) instead shows 'This item is no longer available' with those buttons removed.
Search 'wood'/'WOOD' both returned same 3 items (case-insensitive); 'portland' matched 3 items all with location 'Portland, OR' (location field matched); clearing search restored all 10 items.

browse.count and browse.products updated immediately after each keystroke change (10→3 items for 'wood', 3→6 for 'x') with no separate submit action required; clearing query via fill('') restored count to '10 items available' immediately.

Category(Furniture)+Condition(New) combo: 10→3→2 items, each satisfying both criteria. Price slider min=$250: retained only items ≥$250 ($320,$285). Upcycled toggle: count unchanged (2) since both already upcycled-titled. Sort price-low reordered [$320,$285]→[$285,$320]. Clear all filters restored full 10-item unfiltered set.

Each filter/sort change (category checkbox, condition checkbox, price slider drag, upcycled toggle, sort select) updated browse.products and browse.count immediately with no submit action; 'Clear all filters' action immediately restored unfiltered 10-item listing.

issue: Category selection from Categories page does not apply the category filter to browse results
actual: Clicking 'Furniture' (3 items) on the Categories page navigated to '/?category=furniture' but the browse page showed all 10 items ('10 items available'), not just the 3 Furniture items, and the Furniture checkbox in the filters sidebar remained unchecked (false). The category query param is not being read/applied by the browse page's filter state.
evidence: categories.grid.item.furniture showed '3 items'; after click, URL became /?category=furniture but browse.count remained '10 items available' and browse.filters.categories.item.furniture value=false; confirmed stable after 1s wait, not a loading delay.
